bead.title: Implement safe bounded hot projection mutation
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Operational previews must safely update bounded sets of hot records without racing claims/finalizes or losing concurrent changes. The substrate needs compare-and-set/version behavior, not an unguarded scan/update.

PROPOSED FIX
Implement bounded mutation over a typed indexed query for memory and sqlite with per-record version/CAS checks. The public API should return applied/skipped/conflict counts or a retryable error as defined by the contract. Use the scheduled-action fixture to update only records matching `run_id=job_9001 AND status=scheduled AND is_enrolled_using_open_rate_filter=false`.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs if a mutation trait method is needed.
- crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs.
- crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs.
- crates/pqueue/src/lib.rs.
- crates/pqueue/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Snorri recycling policy calculation.
- Unbounded updates.
- Arbitrary expression execution.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries safe_recycling_rule_update -- --nocapture` passes and marks only `act_001` as suppressed/recycling-updated in the fixture.
2. The same test or a sibling named test proves a concurrent claim/commit version change is rejected or retried cleanly without losing the claim/finalize update.
3. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
